div.div: Only the manager closes, reopens or declines a ticket. A resident who cancels a ticket others follow only stops following it. Followers of a Duplicate move to the original. A Reported ticket with nobody assigned for 24 hours (1 hour if Urgent) is highlighted as late; an Assigned, In progress or On hold ticket past its due date is highlighted as overdue (BM-06).
